**English** | 中文
# dsh-pin
Pin workspaces and sidebar plugin panels to the top of the DeepSeek Harness sidebar. Hover a row, cl
ick 📌; click again and the item returns to its exact former slot. Pins survive reloads and restarts.
| Hover a workspace row | Hover a plugin panel row |
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
GitHub and local checkouts work too (`github:polunzh/dsh-pin`, `link:/path/to/dsh-pin`), as does the
plugin marketplace in DSH settings. Restart DSH or reload the profile afterwards.
## Use
- **Pin a workspace** — hover any row under Workspaces, click 📌. It moves to the top; with several p

ins the most recent comes first.
- **Pin a panel** — hover any sidebar plugin row (third-party panel

s, `Plugins`, `Automation tasks`), click 📌. The other panels keep their registration order.
- **Unpi
n** — click 📌 again, or click the small pin that pinned items always display.
The button matches the native row buttons (24×24 hit area) and never opens or collapses the workspac
e folder behind it. Pinned rows keep a visible pin so their state reads without hovering.
## What DSH already ships
| | Built in | dsh-pin adds |

| Workspace order | drag only | pin to top |
| Workspace pin state | none | persisted, exact restore

|
| Session pin | `pinnedSessionIds` | left alone |
| Panel `order` | fixed at registration | pin t
o top, ordered per browser |
## How it works
- Workspace order uses the host's own `workspaces.insertBefore` RPC, so the durable registry stores

it and every client agrees on it.
- Unpinning inserts the item before the workspace that used to fol

low it; a missing anchor falls back to the end of the list.
- New workspaces are created at the head
of the registry. The plugin watches order changes and pulls pins back up, leaving the remaining ord

er alone.
- Panel order is DOM-only: rows get reordered and the order recorded under `dsh-pin.panels

.v1`, with unpin restoring slot registration order.
- A `MutationObserver` re-injects buttons after

React re-renders and replays panel order.
- The host half is a no-op; all logic lives in `lib/client

re-renders and replays panel order.
- The host half is a no-op; all logic lives in `lib/client.js`.
## Limits

- Web GUI and the desktop web layer only; the TUI has no sidebar.
- "Ungrouped" is not a real worksp

ace and cannot be pinned.
- Workspace order is global to the host; panel order is per browser.
- Dra

gging a pinned item down snaps it back — unpin first.
- Depends on internal DOM (`data-row-key`, `pa
nelRow`, React fiber), so a major DSH upgrade can disable the buttons until the selectors are update

d.
- Debug hook: `window.__dshPin` (`workspaceOrder()`, `panelPins`, `lastError`, `reassertPins()`).
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
End-to-end tests need a running DSH web instance and headless Chrome reachable over CDP:

API contracts and DOM experiments: docs/API-NOTES.md, docs/DOM-CONTRACTS.md.
## Publishing
CI runs the unit tests and the bundle check. A push to `main` publishes through npm trusted publishi
ng (OIDC) whenever `package.json` carries a new version, so the repo holds no long-lived token.
